title: 第一卷 人生初见 第三章 长孙府第一卷 人生初见 第四章 九州大陆
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
想着少爷刚才说的话，初黎有些睡不着，这三个多月虽然在这贫民窟过得艰苦，但初黎却感觉很满足。
在府里的日子虽然衣食无忧，但天天勾心斗角让初黎感到疲惫与厌倦。并且少爷现在在府里的位置很微妙，虽然有家主护着少爷，但从上次家主的表现中不难看出家主已经有心无力，若有一天家主不在了，华夫人必定第一个除掉少爷。
想到这里，初黎再也忍不住了，开口道：“少爷…”
“还没有睡呢。”长孙也并未睡着。
被长孙一打断，初黎到嘴边想说的话也未说出口，“嗯…”
“怎么了，初黎有心事？”长孙问道。
“少爷，我们为什么要回去，我不是想让少爷过这贫民窟的日子，我会干更多活，赚更多银两，这样我们就可以搬出去了，但……我们其实不用回府里。”初黎抓着长孙的胳膊，因为着急以至于有些用力。
“好了，初黎，我知道你在担心什么。放心吧，不用为我担心。”长孙安慰道。
“可是，少爷…”初黎还要说什么却被长孙打断了。
“睡吧，当黎明到来就是新的开始，我们还要迎接新的挑战，所以，养足精神。”长孙说罢，转头看向初黎。
看着长孙坚定的眼神，初黎一颗悬着的心不知为何也静了下来，点了点头，然后抱着长孙的胳膊沉沉的睡去。
第二天，长孙照旧在第一束阳光划破天空时起床了，简单洗漱后，照旧和昨日一样出门散步，等长孙散步回来，初黎已经做好早饭。
两人简单用过早饭，初黎收拾碗筷，待初黎把一切安排妥当后，长孙开口道：“好了，出发吧。”
“嗯…”初黎显然对这居住了三个多月的地方有了感情，情绪有些低落。
长孙看出了初黎的不舍，但离开也是无奈之举，在听完昨天两个家丁的对话后，长孙知道现在的情况回到府中寻求出路是唯一的办法，否则自己与初黎将一辈子生活在华夫人的监视下，若有一天老爷子不在了，华夫人也就再无顾忌了，到时自己与初黎的性命就完全掌握在华夫人的手里了。
初黎恋恋不舍的锁上门，最后看了看这三个多月给了自己温暖的地方，转身跟上长孙离开了这里。
两人就这样离开了这里，在后来的很长时间里两人都再没回来过，在漫长岁月中，这三个多月的回忆一直给两人温暖。
出了贫民窟，两人走在回城的路上，仅仅十几里地，对于长孙来说却是漫长的旅行，从小养尊处优的长孙身体孱弱，体力甚至比不上比自己还小一岁的初黎，所以一路上也是走走停停。
路途中初黎一直心事重重，长孙却是面色平静，二人一路无话，最终还是初黎忍不住打破沉默。
“少爷，我们这样回去华夫人会不会…”初黎本想说华夫人会不会对少爷不测，但想到这样说对华夫人有些不敬，话到一半便又吞了回去。

长孙停下脚步，正巧感到累了，想停下来歇息一阵。
长孙转头看着低头有心事的初黎，猜到她没说完的话，“你是不是想说华夫人对我不怀好意？既然出来了，为什么还要回去自投罗网？”
“嗯…”初黎点点头。
“初黎，你有没有听过一句话，叫最危险的地方就是最安全的地方？华夫人之所以还没有对我动手是因为爷爷的缘故，若在府里我们还能寻求爷爷的庇护，那在这贫民窟我们就像待宰的羔羊，华夫人随时都可以落下悬在我们脖子上的那把刀。”长孙平静的说道，但话语中透漏的狠辣却不似从一个十三岁的少年口中吐出。
“但少爷，老爷的身体…”初黎想说老爷的身体日渐衰弱，可能庇护不了我们多久了，但又想到这样说对老爷不敬，话便又只说了一半。
“爷爷的身体我知道，但现在我们只能回到府中，在绝境中寻找一丝生机。”长孙说道。
听完少爷的话，初黎知道少爷已经打定主意，并且现在两人只有这一条路可走，初黎也就不再纠结。
到了晌午两人终于走到了城门口，看着近在咫尺的丽山城，长孙不由的再一次惊叹。
近看丽山城更加雄伟，扑面而来的气息让长孙感觉在面前的仿佛是一头亘古巨兽。
走进城门，城里与城外仿佛两个世界，城内的喧嚣让几个月来一直过着平静生活的长孙有些不适应，街边摊位上传来各种吆喝叫卖声、砍价声，好不热闹。
两人循着记忆来到长孙府前，整座丽山城倚山而建，建筑物也随着地势建到了山上，而长孙府便建在城里的最高处，如此优越的地势也彰显了长孙家的地位，丽山城的统治者。
长孙看着朱红色的大宅门，府前的两座石狮子惟妙惟肖，似要噬人，与前世电视上的大宅院竟如此契合，只是更显气魄。
长孙迟迟没有进府，初黎则安静的站在少爷身后，两人穿着破烂，就这样痴痴地站在长孙府门口，让人以为是两个没见过世面的叫花子。
看门的下人见两个“乞丐”站在门口迟迟不肯离去，有些不耐烦，大喊道：“哪里来的叫花子，不知道这是长孙府么，赶紧滚到一边去。”
初黎见下人竟敢这样跟少爷说话，正要发作教训教训这个下人，却不想少爷突然张口。
“哪里来的狗奴才，瞎了你的狗眼，连本少爷都认不出来了，还想不想在长孙府待了。”只见长孙仿佛变了一个人，对着下人破口大骂，跋扈的样子比旁边似要噬人的石狮子还要吓人。
看门的下人被长孙突然造成的声势吓了一跳，定睛一看还真是长孙少爷，顿时慌了神，但又忽然想起华夫人曾差人叮嘱，如果少爷回来不要声张，先悄悄的将少爷带到夫人那。
想到这看门的下人一下没了主意，不知道该不该让长孙进府。
长孙见看门的下人愣在门口，还不迎他进门，顿时怒气上头，声音又提高了一倍，大喊道：“你这狗奴才看样子真是吃了熊心豹子胆了，竟敢拦着本少爷，你是不是不想活了。”
被长孙这么一喊，看门的下人更是不知道该怎么做了，头皮一阵发麻。

长孙在门口造成的声势总算是惊动了府里的老管家。老管家来到府前，见门口站的不正是少爷么，赶忙迎上去，“少爷，你总算肯回家了。”
老管家在长孙家已经半辈子了，更是看着长孙长大，对长孙早就有了感情，看着长孙总算回来了，一时激动不已。
content_en:
Thinking about what the young master just said, Chu Li couldn't sleep. Although he had lived in this slum for more than three months, Chu Li felt very satisfied.
Although he had no worries about food and clothing during his time in the mansion, Chu Li felt exhausted and tired of the intrigues every day. Moreover, the young master's current position in the mansion is very delicate. Although the master of the house is protecting the young master, it is not difficult to see from the master's behavior last time that the master is already powerless. If the master is gone one day, Mrs. Hua will be the first to get rid of the young master.
Thinking of this, Chu Li couldn't bear it anymore and said: "Young Master..."
"I haven't slept yet." The eldest grandson didn't fall asleep either.
Being interrupted by Zhang Sun, Chu Li couldn't even say what she wanted to say, "Well..."
"What's wrong? Chu Li is worried?" Changsun asked.
"Master, why should we go back? I don't want the master to live in this slum. I will do more work and earn more money so that we can move out, but... we don't actually need to go back to the house." Chu Li grabbed the eldest grandson's arm, so anxious that he used some force.
"Okay, Chu Li, I know what you are worried about. Don't worry, you don't have to worry about me." Changsun comforted.
"But, Master..." Chu Li was about to say something but was interrupted by Zhang Sun.
"Go to sleep. When dawn comes, it's a new beginning. We have to face new challenges, so keep your spirits up." After Changsun said this, he turned to look at Chu Li.
Seeing Changsun's firm eyes, Chuli's anxious heart calmed down for some reason, nodded, and then fell asleep holding Changsun's arm.
The next day, the eldest grandson got up as usual when the first ray of sunshine broke through the sky. After a simple wash, he went out for a walk as before. When the eldest grandson came back from his walk, Chu Li had already made breakfast.
The two had a simple breakfast, and Chu Li put away the dishes. After Chu Li had arranged everything, Changsun said, "Okay, let's go."
"Well..." Chu Li obviously had feelings for the place where he had lived for more than three months, and he was a little depressed.
The eldest grandson saw Chu Li's reluctance, but he had no choice but to leave. After listening to the conversation between the two servants yesterday, the eldest grandson knew that the only way to return to the house to find a way out of the current situation was to find a way out. Otherwise, he and Chu Li would live under Mrs. Hua's surveillance for the rest of their lives. If one day the old man was gone, Mrs. Hua would no longer have any scruples, and then his and Chu Li's lives would be completely in the hands of Mrs. Hua.
Chu Li reluctantly locked the door, took one last look at the place that had given her warmth for more than three months, turned around and left with her eldest grandson.
The two of them left here like this, and they never came back for a long time. Over the long years, the memories of these three months have always given them warmth.
After leaving the slum, the two walked on the road back to the city. It was only a dozen miles, but it was a long journey for the eldest grandson. The eldest grandson, who had been pampered since childhood, was weak and his physical strength was not even as good as Chu Li, who was one year younger than him, so he stopped and stopped along the way.
Chu Li was always worried during the journey, but Changsun looked calm. The two of them were silent all the way, but Chu Li couldn't help but break the silence in the end.
"Master, if we go back like this, will Mrs. Hua..." Chu Li wanted to say whether Mrs. Hua would do anything untoward to the young master, but she thought that saying this would be disrespectful to Mrs. Hua, so she swallowed her words midway.
Changsun stopped. He happened to feel tired and wanted to stop and rest for a while.
Changsun turned to look at Chu Li, who was looking down thoughtfully, and guessed what she had not finished saying, "Are you trying to say that Mrs. Hua has ill intentions towards me? Now that you have come out, why did you go back and throw yourself into a trap?"
"Well..." Chu Li nodded.
"Chu Li, have you ever heard the saying that the most dangerous place is the safest place? The reason why Mrs. Hua hasn't done anything to me yet is because of grandpa. If we can still seek grandpa's asylum in the house, then hereWe are like lambs waiting to be slaughtered in the slums, and Mrs. Hua can drop the knife hanging on our necks at any time. Changsun said calmly, but the cruelty revealed in his words did not seem to come from the mouth of a thirteen-year-old boy.
"But Master, Master's body..." Chu Li wanted to say that Master's body is getting weaker and weaker, and he may not be able to protect us for much longer, but he thought that saying this would be disrespectful to Master, so he only said half of his words.
"I know about Grandpa's body, but now we can only return to the house and look for a glimmer of hope in a desperate situation. " Changsun said.
After listening to the young master's words, Chu Li knew that the young master had made up his mind, and now there was only one way for the two of them to go, so Chu Li no longer struggled.
At noon, the two finally reached the city gate. Looking at Lishan City so close at hand, Changsun could not help but marvel again.
Lishan City looked even more majestic from a closer look, and the aura that hit his face made Zhangsun feel as if he was facing an ancient giant beast.
Walking into the city gate, the city and the outside seemed like two different worlds. The hustle and bustle in the city made Zhangsun, who had been living a peaceful life for several months, a little uncomfortable. There were all kinds of shouting and bargaining sounds from the street stalls, which was very lively.
The two followed their memories and came to the Changsun Mansion. The entire Lishan City was built against the mountain, and the buildings were built on the mountain according to the terrain. The Changsun Mansion was built at the highest point in the city. Such a superior terrain also highlighted the status of the Changsun family and the rulers of Lishan City.
The eldest grandson looked at the vermilion gate of the mansion. The two stone lions in front of the mansion were lifelike, as if they were about to bite people. They were so consistent with the mansion on TV in his previous life, but they only showed more majesty.
The eldest grandson did not enter the house for a long time, while Chu Li stood quietly behind the young master. The two of them were dressed in tatters and stood infatuatedly at the door of the eldest grandson's house, making people think they were two beggars who had never seen the world.
The servant at the gate saw the two "beggars" standing at the door and refused to leave. He was a little impatient and shouted: "Where are these beggars from? I don't know if this is the Changsun Mansion. Get out of the way." "
When Chu Li saw that this servant dared to talk to the young master like this, he was about to have a fit and teach the servant a lesson, but he didn't expect the young master to suddenly open his mouth.
"Where did you come from, this dog slave? I've blinded your dog eyes and you can't even recognize me. Do you want to stay in the Changsun Mansion anymore? " Changsun seemed to have changed into a different person, shouting curses at his servants, and his domineering look was more frightening than the stone lion next to him that seemed to be biting people.
The servant at the door was startled by the sudden momentum caused by the eldest grandson. He looked closely and saw that it was indeed the eldest grandson's young master. He suddenly panicked, but suddenly remembered that Mrs. Hua had sent someone to tell him not to make any noise if the young master came back, and to quietly bring the young master to the madam.
Thinking of this, the servant who looked after the door suddenly lost his mind and wondered whether he should let the eldest grandson enter the house.
When the eldest grandson saw that the servant guarding the door was stunned at the door and refused to welcome him in, he suddenly became angry and his voice doubled again, and he shouted: "You dog slave seems to be really brave, you dare to stop me, don't you want to live anymore?" "
When the eldest grandson shouted like this, the servant at the door didn't know what to do, and his scalp felt numb.
The momentum created by the eldest grandson at the door finally alerted the old housekeeper in the mansion. The old housekeeper came to the house and saw the young master standing at the door. He hurriedly greeted him, "Master, you are finally willing to go home. "
The old housekeeper has been in the eldest grandson's family for half his life. He has watched his eldest grandson grow up and has feelings for him for a long time. Seeing that his eldest grandson finally came back, he was very excited.
